notes.title: Beneath the Bleeding Moon has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

I'm making an announcement to let you know that [i]Beneath the Bleeding Moon [/i]has (finally) been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/70b21da0c6eb39cb7c621a16a085042789719102.png[/img]

I first showed off the demo of this VN 2 years ago, so getting it across the finish line was a bit of a challenge haha ;; I persevered, however, and now the full visual novel is out!

[i]Bleeding Moon[/i] is a historical boys' love visual novel set in Japan. Follow Haru, a cross-dressing young man, as he goes on a journey with the devious thief, Kishou, to break an ancient curse.

[i]Bleeding Moon[/i] is a little different from my usual visual novels in that it's less of a character drama and more of an adventure story. There's quite a few fight scenes, and it's (generally) light-hearted in tone, though there are a few darker moments.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/58a3b3f6c751b8dc76294c111b49a75b8e9c367a.png[/img]

There's also an r18 patch for anybody who wants it, which adds about 20k more words to the story and several animated(!!!) r18 scenes. This is the first time I've added animated adult CGs into any of my VNs, so I hope people enjoy it.

You can check the VN out here if you're curious:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553080

Thank you for all of your support over the years! It's appreciated! I'll keep working hard to make more visual novels that people will enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: How to Melt a Maiden's Heart has been released! \o/
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm writing a post to let you know that my newest BL VN, [i]How to Melt a Maiden's Heart[/i] (or [i]Melty Heart[/i] for short), has been released! Yay \o/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/efbfe94f60616a4bb726cfa3fa288e2246e53e46.png[/img]

[i]Melty Heart[/i] is a cute slice of life story set on the fictional Japanese island of Omorishima (whose name might ring a bell if you've read my earlier yuri VN, [i]My Dear Prince[/i]. The VNs take place on the same island and there's a couple of references to [i]MDP[/i] in [i]Melty Heart[/i].)

The story centers around Reo, a delinquent who doesn't care about his grades, or his appearance, or school in general, and Yuuma, the serious head of the student council who's always picking fights with Reo. Reo can't stand Yuuma, and the feeling is mutual... But this changes when Reo discovers, quite by accident, that Yuuma has been working part-time at a local café while dressing as a maid.

Reo uses this knowledge to his advantage, and decides to blackmail Yuuma. He coerces Yuuma into helping him with his Love Quest to win over his childhood friend, Chinami. Reo's sure, with Yuuma's help, Chinami will finally fall for him, and they'll be able to live happily ever after...

So why does Reo keep thinking about Yuuma, damn it?!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/3280d29ca52b8266170dfe821c52a4c040c276fc.png[/img]

This VN is suitable for all ages and doesn't contain any sexual content or anything particularly fanservicey, apart from a brief scene of Reo in the bath. There's some cursing, but nothing too excessive. The VN is available on PC, mac, and linux, and you can check it out here:

[url=]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096440[/url]

As always, I hope you enjoy it, and happy early holidays!

- ebi x

notes.title: My Confounding Cat is Criminally Cute has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone \o/

I’m writing a quick post to let you know that I’ve released a shiny VN, [i]My Confounding Cat is Criminally Cute[/i] (that’s such an extra title lmao…)

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/b8127a7a6765fa3002d04ba8d75f0cb067de910a.png[/img]

[i]Criminal Cat[/i] is a relatively short BL VN without any choices or branches. It follows a grumpy wizard, Aster, who lives a reclusive life deep in the woods and brews potions to get by. Aster is taciturn by nature, and he swears he isn’t lonely! He’s perfectly fine keeping to himself, thank you very much…

Until a black cat tumbles down his chimney one day, throwing his whole life into disarray!

After taking the black cat in, Aster soon discovers this clumsy kitten is no ordinary feline. He is, in actuality, a young man called Blaise, who has been cursed by a witch to assume the form of a cat during the sunlight hours – but why? What did Blaise do to get cursed, and can Aster help him?

It’ll be a huge pain, but Aster will (reluctantly) do his best. He’ll never be able to get rid of Blaise if he can’t, and all Aster really wants is a quiet life. It’s not like he’s going to fall for his catboy companion or anything, right?

…Right?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/89d5e81952b23d62d10d692eeb78f042ffc53244.png[/img]

[i]Criminal Cat[/i] is a pretty sweet and light story, and it doesn’t contain any explicit content. The steamiest thing you’ll find here are a handful of kiss scenes (well, how else are you supposed to break a curse?!)

The adorable art is by Ekkoberry,​ who handled the character sprites, CGs, and the UI! I usually work with multiple artists per project, so having one person manage all of the art-related tasks was a pretty new experience for me. I’m really happy with how this VN turned out: I think it looks very cute and cohesive!

Please consider checking the VN out if you're interested! It's not that long, so it's pretty cheap! And, as always, feel free to leave a review to let me know what you think. Reviews are very helpful for small developers such as myself, as they help push my games to more people and can boost discoverability!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2685600

- ebi x

notes.title: BL VN Rain and the Wolf has been released 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that my latest VN, [i]Rain and the Wolf,[/i] has been released!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/d942bbe009c7686c0a457563b23c491b5e0e0d1a.png[/img]

Rain and the Wolf is a BL visual novel inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. The story follows Rain, an aloof young man, who works as an apothecary with his father. One day, Rain's father sends him into the woods to gather some herbs, but Rain finds himself entrenched in his childhood memories and wanders off the beaten path.

While Rain is resting by the riverside, a sudden storm blows by and he gets caught up in a downpour. In the confusion, he falls and sprains his ankle, and passes out from the pain as the hour wears on. It seems inevitable that Rain will become food for the hungry wolves that prowl the woods, but fortune smiles on him. A passing young man, Zero, finds him, and takes Rain  back to his home to recuperate — but there's a catch.

Zero is no ordinary man. He's a werewolf, and his designs on Rain might not be as innocent as it first seems.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/4c73667fc1c242e5e615827bbaadc5814150d208.png[/img]

This is a visual novel with choices and branches. Guide Rain, and try to unravel the truth behind Zero without being chomped on. Though (generally) good-natured, it's possible to antagonise Zero, which can result in a couple of pretty grim endings (including one Very Bad Ending). It's easy enough to avoid the bad endings if you don't want to see them, however.

If you only read the good endings this story is relatively sweet and light. I would advise people to read the content warnings on the game's page carefully before deciding if they want to check it out, however, as I don't want to upset people by subjecting them to any content they might find upsetting.

You can purchase the game on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3016500/Rain_and_the_Wolf/

I've also put my other BL VNs on sale to celebrate the release of this VN, yay 🎉
You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32514/EbiHime_BL_Bundle/]check the sale out here[/url] if you're interested!

- ebi x

notes.title: Dark BL VN All Scars and Starlight has been released \o/
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I'm making this announcement to let you know that my dark boys love / boys hate visual novel, [i]All Scars and Starlight[/i], has been released!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/6cd133b875288f1a6e0349c97ad40ec2224158f5.png[/img]

[i]Scars[/i] is a grim story about a deposed king, Yuel, who is taken prisoner by the leader of a rebellion and his older cousin, Tavi. Though Yuel initially despises Tavi for overthrowing him, complicated feelings begin to develop between the pair as Tavi refuses to have Yuel executed, despite the warnings of his advisors.

Wanting to keep Yuel safe, Tavi hides Yuel away in the palace where his political enemies can’t hurt him - but the biggest threat to Yuel’s life soon proves to be Yuel himself.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/de020a27bcc39533575d283937e47639f221e0e3.png[/img]

The story has choices and multiple endings, so there’s a few different ways it can pan out. It’s quite a grim story which deals with topics like self-harm, suicide, and sexual assault, and the main pairing are cousins. The story also contains explicit sexual content, so you need to be 18+ to check it out.

You can check [i]Scars[/i] out here, if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827190/

[i]Scars[/i] takes place in the same universe as a couple of my other VNs, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i] and [i]All Idleness and Ephemera[/i]. If you want to read more about the world setting in [i]Scars[/i] you can check those out here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020/All_Ashes_and_Illusions/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025720/All_Idleness_and_Ephemera/

And I've written some cute alternate universe stories about Yuel and Tavi that're completely divorced from the world present in [i]Ashes[/i], [i]Idleness[/i], and [i]Scars[/i], which can be found here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146500/Unluckily_in_Love/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2513080/To_Have_and_to_Hold/

Phew. That's a lot of words about Yuel and Tavi haha ;;;
I really have written a lot of stories about them over the last couple of years, haven't I?

I feel like I've talked a lot so I'll end here. If you want some quality BL Suffering then I hope you'll give [i]Scars[/i] a try at least. I poured a lot of love into it, and it was very much a project of passion!

- ebi x

notes.title: Unluckily in Love updated \o/

I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that I've released a free update for my cute BL VN, [i]Unluckily in Love![/i]

notes.title: BL VN All Scars and Starlight has been announced! ✨
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm writing an announcement to let you know that the Steam store page for my upcoming yaoi visual novel, [i]All Scars and Starlight[/i], is now live!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/b1a8e04fe14b3808d60b195e5cb0a8094df7c1a5.png[/img]

It's a grim little story about a deposed king being imprisoned by, and falling for, his captor (who just so happens to be his cousin). There are choices and multiple endings, plus a bunch of political drama and Suffering.

[i]Scars[/i] is an r18 VN, so there are several uncensored sex scenes. The story also deals with discomforting topics like suicide and sexual assault, though all of the sex scenes depicted in this story are consensual.

You can check the VN out here, and maybe drop it a wishlist if you're interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827190

[i]Scars[/i] is a spin-off of my dark BxG VN, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i], which features the same characters but ends rather differently. You can read [i]Scars[/i] without reading [i]Ashes[/i], but reading [i]Ashes[/i] will probably make [i]Scars[/i] a better experience.

You can take a look at [i]Ashes[/i] here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

The characters from [i]Scars[/i], Yuel and Tavi, also appear in a few of my other BL VNs, [i]All Idleness and Ephemera[/i], [i]Unluckily in Love[/i], and [i]To Have and to Hold[/i]. I'm pretty fond of writing about Yuel and Tavi (as if that was not immediately obvious lmao), so if you want to read about them in other, slightly happier scenarios, you have a lot of options! [i]To Have and to Hold[/i] is also free, if that's of any interest.

I hope you look forward to the story! I'm hoping to release it in 3 or 4 months! 🙏

- ebi x

notes.title: BL VN In Fair Spirits has been released 💚✨
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! \o/

I'm writing this announcement to let you know that I've released a new VN on Steam (though you might have seen it already if you follow my developer page haha), [i]In Fair Spirits[/i]!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/b4bca2b31616e8d7b7e6fb1f21e6869ecc86b5b9.png[/img]


[i]In Fair Spirits[/i] ​is a sweet and wholesome slice of life story which details the slowly developing relationship between Edmund, a knight from medieval England who finds himself reincarnated into the 21st century for... reasons, and Abel, a peppy goth boy who speaks in incomprehensible internet slang that Edmund can't understand.

(Yes, Abel is a Tumblr user. Yes, his dialogue is peppered with various dated Tumblr memes/references from 2013/14. No, I will not apologise for this... Though maybe Abel should lol...)

Edmund and Abel might seem like polar opposites but they soon discover they have a few things in common (spoilers: it's trauma). They wind up bonding, and then...

Well, this is a romance story, so things inevitably go in a lovey-dovey direction! 💚

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e420174b76ed8a9ee0e0e3e5d9ec548c8ce0ab6a.png[/img]


[i]In Fair Spirits[/i] is actually the third in a series, the first being ​[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1244260][i]The Fairy's Song[/i][/url] ​and the second being ​[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1994760][i]The Fairy's Secret​[/i][/url]. [i]​In Fair Spirits[/i] ​is a direct sequel to ​[i]The Fairy's Secret​[/i], and it takes place around a year after the events of that story. You don't need to have read ​[i]Fairy's Song[/i] ​or ​[i]Fairy's Secret[/i] ​to grasp what happens here, though, so if you just want BL fluff you can jump straight into this story without any problems.

Alternatively, if you're only interested in cute yuri fluff ([i]The Fairy's Song[/i] and [i]Secret[/i] are both yuri VNs), then you should probably give [i]In Fair Spirits[/i] a miss. Marnie and Lisbeth, the lead couple from [i]Song/Secret[/i], do appear here, but their appearances are more like cameos, and they don't have much screentime.

If this story sounds like your cup of tea, then you can check it out here! 💚

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2622770

As always, thank you for all of your support! Since I write a lot of different stoires in different genres, I know they won't always appeal to everybody, but I hope at least some people have fun with this!

- ebi x
